patterns.label: Absolute
patterns.explain: An absolute noun stands on its own. It is not the first noun of a construct chain, or it is the last noun of one.

patterns.label: Construct
patterns.explain: A construct noun is linked to the noun that follows it, usually in a relationship that can be translated “of”. The accent is drawn to the final noun of the chain, so a construct noun may show vowel reduction.
